description: Returns the link to join the Catch of a Lifetime waitlist (free for founding members), optionally crediting a friend's referral code. The person signs up themselves on the page; this tool does not collect email addresses.

metro.description: Optional metro, to include its launch progress.

referral_code.description: Optional 8-character referral code from a friend who's already on the waitlist.

name: get_waitlist_link
title: Get Waitlist Link
